## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. Note any platform or live behavior
you could not verify.

- [ ] New runtime behavior has a test that fails without the change.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck and affected tests pass.
- [ ] Public text and attachments contain no credentials or personal identifiers.
- [ ] Release or installer changes preserve hashes, semver ordering and fallback behavior.
